title: Three Meetings and One Short Sheet
subtitle: 规则规范 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 规则规范（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·规则与规范）
meta: 主题语境：规则规范（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·规则与规范）　|　核心词汇：guideline　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 guideline 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1982 the officer ① issued a guideline that no clerk in the office would have described, and he said the issuing was the whole of the meeting. The ② guideline, meaning the rule itself and not the notice, ran three meetings and stayed undescribed in the book; a guideline, he said, is the only thing in an office that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ guideline in that office had the same short sheet beside it, and the ④ guideline at the far board, meaning the one they kept for the children and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A guideline, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the officer said the describing is the part that fills three meetings.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the guideline was the whole of the matter, meaning the principle and not the rule. The ⑥ guideline, meaning the principle and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; guideline, he said, is either something you issue or the only word that means both a rule and a principle. He said the principle is the part they remember.

By 1987 the ⑦ guideline had become a line in a manual, and the manual had become an argument about the short sheet. The ⑧ guideline of the whole thing, the officer wrote in November, was one office and three meetings of describing; guideline, he said, is either the one at the far board or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ guideline I remember is the one described in the manual, which closed in 1989 and is still described as the quietest in the office. A ⑩ guideline, my mother said in 1991, is the only one that improves by being described; every guideline, she said, is a principle that has agreed to look like a rule. She said the principle was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 指导方针；准则（指办公室里每一条旁边的那一条）
B. n. 指导方针；准则（指那条规定本身，与通知相对）
C. 固定搭配：issue a guideline 发布一项准则
D. n. 准则（指留给孩子们学着看的那一版）
E. n. 规范（抽象总称，指一间办公室的规范之事）
F. n. 准则（指手册里写到、被记下的那一条）
G. n. 参考线；标线（指一件事里人人都照却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 基准（抽象总称，指人人都照却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: issued a guideline that no clerk in the office would have described
The guideline, meaning the rule itself and not the notice
the guideline at the far board
the guideline was the whole of the matter
the guideline had become a line in a manual
The guideline of the whole thing
A guideline, my mother said in 1991

answers.why: issue a guideline 意为“发布一项准则”，1982 年那位官员发布了办公室里没有一位办事员肯描述的一项准则。
guideline 意为“指导方针、准则”，指那条规定本身而不是通知，它经过了三次会议而在簿子上没有被描述。
guideline 意为“指导方针、准则”，指办公室里每一条旁边的那一条，每一条旁边都有同一页矮矮的纸。
guideline 意为“准则”，指最远那块板上留给孩子们学着看的那一版，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
guideline 意为“参考线、基准”，指一件事里人人都照却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这条基准就是那件事的全部。
guideline 意为“基准”，指人人都照却无人提起的那样东西而不是那条准则，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
guideline 意为“准则”，指手册里写到、被记下的那一条，到 1987 年这一条成了手册里的一行。
guideline 意为“规范”，官员十一月写道，整件事的规范之事是一间办公室和三次会议的描述。
guideline 意为“准则”，我记得的是手册里描述过的那一条，1989 年修订了，至今仍被说成办公室里最安静的一条。
guideline 为抽象总称，母亲 1991 年说，准则是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的规定。
